audit.whatIsWrong: Layers contradict on lane difficulty: full says HARD 8/10 with Yone winning all seven stages; content and packet levelChart give Mel all seven; WR is 49.04%.

Spikes covered: his Q3/level-2 threat, level 6 Fate Sealed, Mel first-item and 2+ item windows. Content spike entries exist for all four.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated mechanics: (1) Mel's R 'reflects and executes his ult' / 'turns his own damage back on him' — Golden Eclipse only strikes marked enemies per Overwhelm stacks; the reflect lives on W (Rebuttal). Appears in whys[4], whys[6], spikes[1], spikes[3], mid, late. (2) Mel 'stacks Q to the empowered third cast' — Mel's Q has no third-cast mechanic; that is Yone's Q3, transplanted onto the owner (spikes[0], wants.you[0]). Also 'R-taunts' — Fate Sealed pulls, it does not taunt.
audit.why: Kit texts: Mel R deals damage per Overwhelm stacks, no reflect; Mel Q is a single barrage; Yone R 'pulls all enemies hit towards him'.
audit.corrected: All rewritten: survive the all-in behind Rebuttal's barrier, then cash Golden Eclipse on banked stacks; Q3 references now belong to Yone only; taunt language removed.

Zhonya's-vs-divers line applies; content also names Liandry's/Blackfire as alternates — inconsistent with report[8]'s Luden's, noted for the user.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Yone wins by shielding through your chip with Spirit Cleave, then cashing Q3 airborne into Fate Sealed before you can kite.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rebuttal has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1, 10s max — his burst window; survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. - Mortal Steel cycles every 4s: count two hits, the third is the knockup. - Your 38s Rebuttal answers exactly one all-in; the R closes it.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: His E snap-back path is fixed — drop Solar Snare's root on the body he must return to and the all-in ends where it started.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Two Mortal Steel stacks mean the Q3 dash-knockup is loaded — volleying rooted in place hands him the airborne into Fate Sealed.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse at 6 reflects and executes his ult, hard-countering the all-in that is his whole win condition.
edits.after: Golden Eclipse at 6 cashes your banked Overwhelm the moment his all-in leaves him low — his dive feeds your execute.

edits.before: Two items plus you're a reflect engine he cannot dive without feeding his own combo back into himself.
edits.after: Two items plus, you're a fortress he can't dive: Rebuttal blanks his burst and the execute ends the rest.

edits.before: Once you have Q Radiant Volley stacked to the empowered third cast and E Solar Snare, you control every trade: snare him mid-Q or as he dashes with his E and unload the wave of missiles into a body that can't move. His Q3 knockup and the Xin-style Q spam are melee-range, so as long as you respect Rebuttal timing and W-cancel his committed autos, you win the poke war outright.
edits.after: Once you have Q Radiant Volley and E Solar Snare, you control every trade: snare him mid-Q or as he dashes with his E and unload the full barrage into a body that can't move. His 450-range Mortal Steel and its Q3 knockup are melee problems, so as long as you keep Rebuttal for his committed engage and kite the 4-second Q cycle, you win the poke war outright.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse is a nightmare for Yone because his entire threat is his all-in: when he R-taunts or dashes back to his spirit with E, pop R to reflect and execute. If he ults you, your R turns his own damage back on him, so his 6 all-in that beats most mages simply doesn't function into Mel.
edits.after: Golden Eclipse is a nightmare for Yone because his entire threat is his all-in: survive it behind Rebuttal — the barrier stops his damage cold — while every hit you land banks Overwhelm. Pop R as his Soul Unbound snap-back lands and the execute deletes him; the 6 all-in that beats most mages doesn't function into Mel.

edits.before: Two items plus you're a mid-teamfight reflect engine that Yone cannot dive without feeding his own combo back into his face. Land E to peel his Q3 knockup or his ult, and your R deletes him the moment he channels his second-form all-in onto your carries.
edits.after: Two items plus you're a mid-teamfight fortress Yone cannot dive: Rebuttal blanks his burst window outright. Land E to peel his Q3 knockup or his ult, and Golden Eclipse deletes him the moment he throws his second-form all-in onto your stacked carries.

edits.before: This is your zone. With E Solar Snare up you punish every Yone dash — snare him as he E-returns to his spirit and the fight is over before his knockup even threatens. At 6 your Golden Eclipse hard-counters his ult and his taunt-dash all-in: reflect the burst and execute. Don't roam blindly, but you're strong enough to shove and follow his flanks.
edits.after: This is your zone. With E Solar Snare up you punish every Yone dash — snare him as he E-returns to his spirit and the fight is over before his knockup even threatens. At 6, ride out his Fate Sealed engage behind Rebuttal, then cash Golden Eclipse on the banked stacks. Don't roam blindly, but you're strong enough to shove and follow his flanks.

edits.before: With items you become a reflect wall Yone can't cross. Every all-in he throws — R, E-dash, Q3 knockup — is punishable by your snare and turned around by Golden Eclipse. Peel for your team, hold R for his engage, and you win the extended fight; the only losing pattern is over-extending without Rebuttal or E available.
edits.after: With items you become a wall Yone can't cross. Every all-in he throws — R, E-dash, Q3 knockup — is punishable by your snare and blanked by Rebuttal's barrier, then Golden Eclipse cleans up. Peel for your team, hold R for his engage, and you win the extended fight; the only losing pattern is over-extending without Rebuttal or E available.

notes: Killed two fabricated mechanics: Mel's R does not reflect anything (the reflect is W Rebuttal; R is a stack-cashing global strike), and Mel has no 'empowered third Q cast' — that was Yone's Q3 pasted onto the owner. Fate Sealed pulls, it does not taunt; removed 'R-taunts'. Level chart left entirely alone: full says Yone 7/7 (HARD 8/10), content+packet say Mel 7/7, WR 49.04% — cannot be settled from kits, raised as a user question (pre-existing cross-layer disagreement, none introduced). Item inconsistency noted: report[8] says Luden's first, spikes[2] says Liandry's/Blackfire — user should pick one build voice. Did not verify whether Yone's Q3 wind counts as a reflectable projectile (kit flag absent) so no claim was made either way.
